projects.remarks:
GSK is procuring a digital listening tool to track HCP presence and generate insights across key therapeutic areas and markets. Commercial evaluation has been completed for four suppliers, with PeakData identified as the preferred supplier. Negotiations with PeakData are currently ongoing, and the Business Owner (BO) is expected to initiate the TPRM process next week.

This is a one-time POC RFP covering the initial implementation. Following evaluation of the POC results, individual countries are expected to procure the solution based on their respective requirements.
